name: grounded-copy
description: Help AI write clearly and get to the point.

interface.shortDescription: Help AI write clearly and get to the point.
interface.longDescription: Grounded Copy makes the assistant state the fact and get to the point, in chat replies and in the documents it writes. A separate mode applies stricter rules to product pages and marketing copy, and saved files can be checked on request.
defaultPrompt: Explain how compound interest works, in plain words.
Summarize this document for someone who has not read it. Keep every warning and limit.
Write a product description from the facts I give you.
